Now lift your voice and decree by the power of the blood of Jesus, my life is untouchable. My family is unmovable. My finances are unstoppable. My health is unshakable. My destiny is unchangeable. I walk in victory. I walk in speed. I walk in breakthrough. Father, we exalt you. You are the breaker of chains, the lifter of men, the destroyer of altars. We thank you because altars are down, yolks are destroyed, burdens are lifted, and destinies are free. Beloved, go to bed with this assurance. No altar will speak against you again. No stagnation will hold you again. No chain will tie you again. For if the sun shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.
